items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Press and the label swaps with a short lift; six intents from primary to destructive. One primary action per section.
items.docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Visual intent of the button surface and text.
configurables.how: One primary per section. Use destructive-* only for irreversible actions. Default: primary.

configurables.what: Hit target and type scale of the control.
configurables.how: m for forms and content; s/xs for dense toolbars; l/xl for hero CTAs. Default: m.

configurables.what: Whether the label text-swap animation runs on hover/press.
configurables.how: false in dense tables or reduced-motion; true for marketing CTAs when motion is wanted. Default matches source: false.

configurables.what: Shows a busy state and blocks re-clicks while work is in flight.
configurables.how: true only during async submit; pair with disabled if the form must not resubmit.

configurables.what: Prevents interaction and dims the control.
configurables.how: true when prerequisites are unmet; prefer explaining why nearby, not only a dead button.

gotchas.note: Text-swap animation needs the real label as children string/node; do not replace children with a custom spinner while loading — use the loading prop.
Keep a clear accessible name; icon-only usage belongs on icon-button, not button with empty children.
Button CSS is global BEM (.btn*). Import the published stylesheet globally; CSS Modules will scope classes and break styles.

agent.usage:
import { Button } from '@/components/atoms/Button';

<Button variant="primary" size="m" animated>
  Save
</Button>

items.name: icon-button

items.docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. configurables.what: Visual intent of the square icon control.
configurables.how: Match the surrounding button family. One primary per section; destructive only for irreversible actions. Default: primary.

configurables.what: Hit target of the icon-only control.
configurables.how: m for toolbars; s/xs for dense tables; l/xl for hero chrome. Default: m.

configurables.what: Prevents interaction and dims the control.
configurables.how: true when the action is unavailable; prefer a tooltip explaining why. Default: false.

configurables.what: Shows busy state and blocks re-clicks.
configurables.how: true only during async work; pair with disabled semantics for forms. Default: false.

configurables.what: Whether the icon rotation / motion runs on interaction.
configurables.how: true for marketing chrome; false in data-dense tables or reduced-motion contexts. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Always provide an accessible name (aria-label) — there is no visible text children.
Uses global BEM (.button*). Import published CSS globally; Modules will scope and break styles.

agent.usage:
import { IconButton } from '@/components/atoms/IconButton';

<IconButton variant="ghost" size="m" aria-label="Close" />

items.docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

configurables.what: Surface treatment of the status tag.
configurables.how: filled for primary status; outlined for quiet meta; ghost for inline. Default: filled.

configurables.what: Semantic color of the tag.
configurables.how: neutral for meta; success/warning/danger for state; brand/ai sparingly. Default: neutral.

configurables.what: Type and padding scale.
configurables.how: s default; xs for dense tables; m for marketing. Default: s.

configurables.what: Shows a leading status dot.
configurables.how: true for live/status lists; false for pure labels. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Tags are not interactive by default — do not use them as buttons; use Chip or Button.

agent.usage:
import { Tag } from '@/components/atoms/Tag';

<Tag variant="filled" intent="success" size="s">
  Live
</Tag>
